description: List a folder: names, kinds, sizes, labels. Paths: anywhere in the sandbox. Some places are blocked for every AI. Read only. Allowed without asking.

name: files_read

name: files_write

to.description: New path, or a folder ending with / to move it into (created if missing). Anywhere in the sandbox.

name: files_move

description: Copy a file exactly (contents untouched). End `to` with / to copy into a folder. Paths: anywhere in the sandbox. Some places are blocked for every AI. Changes files, can be undone. Allowed under this capability.

from.description: File to copy. Anywhere in the sandbox.

to.description: New path, or a folder ending with / (created if missing). Anywhere in the sandbox.

name: files_copy

name: files_trash

description: Send an email, optionally attaching one file. Paths: anywhere in the sandbox. Some places are blocked for every AI. Can't be undone, so the owner is always asked first. The call may wait for an answer or be refused. Sends data off the computer. If the goal read untrusted content or Finance/Sensitive files, the owner is asked and shown where the data came from.

attach.description: Optional file to attach. Anywhere in the sandbox.

name: mail_send

description: Find files under a folder by name or meaning: words in the name, a label (Finance, Work...), or "untrusted"/"web". Paths: anywhere in the sandbox. Some places are blocked for every AI. Read only. Allowed without asking.

query.description: Words in the name, a label (Finance, Work, Personal), or "untrusted".

name: files_find

from.description: File to move. Anywhere in the sandbox.

to.description: Destination. End with / to move into a folder (it's created if missing), e.g. "Downloads/Finance/". Anywhere in the sandbox.

name: files_organize

description: Run a read-only command (ls, du, git status, grep...) in a sandbox that sees only the given folders, with no network. Words, never a shell line. Allowed without asking.

argv.description: One command as words: the program's plain name, then its arguments. Never a shell line.

pipeline.description: Commands joined by pipes, each as words. Give argv or pipeline, not both.

stdin.description: Text for the first command's input (up to 64 KB).

cwd.description: Folder to run in; the command sees only this pass's folders. Anywhere in the sandbox.
